::: {#about}

[Bioinformatics · Genomics · Scalable pipelines]{.hero-tagline}

[[<i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> Nextflow Ambassador]{.badge-pill}
[<i class="bi bi-rocket-takeoff"></i> Founder of Genobit]{.badge-pill}
[<i class="bi bi-mortarboard"></i> PhD candidate · Unicentro]{.badge-pill}]{.hero-badges}

I am a Biomedical Scientist specialized in microbiology and molecular biology, currently a PhD candidate in Pharmaceutical Sciences at Unicentro (Brazil) and enrolled in an MBA in Data Science & Analytics at USP/Esalq. I teach clinical immunology, clinical bacteriology and clinical biochemistry at Centro Universitário Uniguairacá.

My research and technical work focus on **bioinformatics, computational biology and genomics**. I am especially interested in building and optimizing scalable workflows for complex biological data, and in developing pipelines for tumor genomics and variant calling.

I am the founder of **Genobit**, a startup providing computational solutions for biological data, and a **Nextflow Ambassador**, helping the community adopt this essential tool for reproducible bioinformatics.

:::
